title: Ontario permit-to-start-to-completion conversion evidence
question: Which permit intentions become starts, completions, and occupancy?
why_it_matters: Building permits are upstream intentions. FTFN needs conversion evidence to know whether approvals become starts, completions, occupied units, or stalled projects.
current_support: FTFN has Statistics Canada permits, CMHC starts and completions data, Toronto's 2025 Development Pipeline, application 24 254930 records showing movement from initial notice through staff review to a July 2026 committee recommendation, and a full-address Building Permit portal recheck.
missing_evidence: building permit and permit-to-start conversion for application 24 254930
candidate_records: specific Toronto building permit for application 24 254930
application 24 254930 start, completion, and occupancy record
next_action: Recheck the Council and bill trail after July 29-31, then search the Building Permit portal with a confirmed application number or later project record and track construction start, completion, and occupancy.
notes: Phase 55H searched all eight project addresses in the official Building Permit portal; each returned Application Not Found. Those bounded negative queries do not prove that no permit exists, so the permit-to-start-to-completion gap remains open.
